pl-l3d27c3-d1e115.summary: Asks whether God and neighbor are loved by the same love or whether love of God and of neighbor differ.

pl-l3d27c3-d1e118.summary: Answers that God and neighbor are loved by the same love, which (sentence continues in the next paragraph)
claims: One love loves God and neighbor.

pl-l3d27c3-d1e121.summary: Completes the answer: this love is the Holy Spirit, as said above, because God is love.
claims: The charity by which God and neighbor are loved is the Holy Spirit.

pl-l3d27c3-d1e125.summary: Quotes Augustine on 1 John 4:20: one who does not love the brother he sees cannot love God, whom he does not see; if he loved the brother with spiritual charity, he would see God, who is charity, with the inner eye. By one and the same charity we love God and neighbor, but God for God, and ourselves and neighbor for God.
claims: Whoever does not love the brother cannot love God, who is love.
By one charity we love God for himself and neighbor for God.

pl-l3d27c3.summary: Asks whether God and neighbor are loved by the same love or by different loves. The same love, which is the Holy Spirit, since God is love, as was said in Book 1. Augustine on 1 John: one cannot love God unseen without loving the brother seen, since God is the love that one lacks if one does not love the brother; by one and the same charity we love God for God and ourselves and neighbor for God.
claims: God and neighbor are loved by one and the same charity.
That charity is the Holy Spirit.
